$description: Fishlog / fwapp - Cosy tackle design tokens. W3C DTCG format, importable by Tokens Studio for Figma. Extracted from app/web/static/style.css, which is the source of truth: if these disagree, the stylesheet wins. Contrast figures are from tools/palette_check.py, which fails the test suite when a pair drops below its minimum.

canvas.$description: The page ground. Kraft khaki, matte, light on purpose - sunlight collapses perceived contrast and a light ground is what survives it.

canvas-deep.$description: Recessed ground. Also the interior of the conditions ring.

surface.$description: Raised tray. Cards sit on this.

line.$description: Default 1px rim on every card and tray.

line-strong.$description: Emphasised rim, and the neutral ring stroke.

ink.$description: Primary text. Deep bark, tinted warm from the ground - flat grey on a warm ground reads as dirt. 13.39:1 on surface.

ink-faint.$description: Least emphasis, still AA. 5.63:1 on surface. Do not go lighter.

accent.$description: Burnt amber. LOCKED for the whole app: links and the one primary action per screen. A green app does not grow a blue button on one screen. 4.64:1 on the worst ground.

accent-deep.$description: Emphasis text and the primary-button hover.

band.$description: Day quality. Traffic light, green good to red bad. The TINT is a fill that text sits on; the MARK is the signal. THE FOUR MARKS ARE RESERVED - no decorative element may use a mark hue at mark saturation, or an ornament beside a warning stops the warning reading as one. A band hue appears only where a day is being reported.

green-mark.$description: RESERVED. 3.95:1 on its tint, 3.88:1 on canvas-deep.

yellow-mark.$description: RESERVED. 3.64:1 on its tint, 3.44:1 on canvas-deep.

orange-mark.$description: RESERVED. 3.77:1 on its tint, 3.67:1 on canvas-deep.

red-mark.$description: RESERVED. 4.21:1 on its tint, 4.56:1 on canvas-deep.

positive-ink.$description: Text on the green tint and the accent wash.

warn-ink.$description: Text on the orange and red tints; field errors.

water.$description: Lake shapes only - thumbnails, outlines. Muted sage. Deliberately NOT the accent (amber reads as land) and NOT a band hue (green would read as a good day). Also used for two of the six ambient fish.

water-deep.$description: Lake shape gradient end. Also used for two of the six ambient fish.

spacing.$description: 4px base. A 4-base keeps the middle steps an 8-only scale throws away; rhythm comes from mixing tight against generous.

radius.$description: The brief asked for round shapes. Nothing in this app has a sharp corner.
Cards, trays, the hero, the map wrap.

radius-pill.$description: Badges, the segmented switch, the session float, the conditions ring.

body.$description: Body, labels, readouts. Self-hosted, variable 400-700, split latin / latin-ext / cyrillic by unicode-range.

display.$description: h1-h3 only. Baloo 2 has NO CYRILLIC - Nunito sits behind it in the stack so Russian headings fall through. That is deliberate; do not add a Cyrillic Baloo file.

tight.$description: Headings. Tracking tightens as size grows - a heading set at display size with body tracking reads loose.

shadow.$description: Three steps and no more; if everything is raised, nothing is. Tinted to the bark ink - a pure black shadow on a warm ground is dirt.

out.$description: Never ease-in on UI: it delays the moment the eye is already waiting on.

water.$description: Slight overshoot, for anything that should feel buoyant.
